parsed.internal_thinking: ג'מה just placed a starting settlement at node 20 and called me out publicly about my betrayal from last game. He's warning me not to do it again. This is a direct address about our history. He's also signaling his strategy (brick and sheep). I need to acknowledge this socially—not defensively, but with some charm and self-awareness. I should show I'm aware of what happened and that I'm willing to play straight this time, at least early. This sets a better tone and may help rebuild some trust, even if it's fragile. ג'ימי is watching too—he knows I'm capable of dealing but also that I can be useful. I should be light, not overly apologetic (that would seem weak), but genuine enough to reset the table dynamic.
parsed.note_to_self: ג'מה placed at node 20 (yields from hexes 9, 8, 4): Wheat 9, Sheep 4, Wood 11—solid brick/sheep setup as he said. He's explicitly wary of me after last game betrayal. ג'ימי also present and knows I deal. Need to rebuild trust early through fair play and honest table talk, not through overly aggressive moves. Watch for ג'מה trying to block me or form coalition against me.
parsed.say_outloud: חייך, ג'מה—אתה צודק, הפעם אני משחק נקי. לא היה לי ברירה אחרת בפעם שעברה, אבל זה לא חוזר על עצמו. בהצלחה לך עם הטיט והכבשה. 😊
